notes: «كلهم عن الجريري» writes Jariri once for all three branches: the tail carries the second occurrence, and branch 1's own «حدثنا الجريري» is that same node (rule 3).
«حدثني شيخ، من طفاوة» stays unnamed (rule 8). Abu Hurayra is last because his own words are the matn.
The closing «وقال موسى حدثنا حماد عن الجريري عن أبي نضرة عن الطفاوي» restates branch 3 and names the shaykh only by nisba: not a new group, not filled in. «قال أبو داود» remarks are left out.
